title: Replit Agent: Features, Pricing, Credits & Alternatives

facts.fact: Replit's Starter plan is free and includes daily Agent credits and limited publishing.
facts.quote: Entry plan for exploring Replit with daily Agent credits and limited publishing.

facts.fact: Replit's Core plan costs $20 per month, or $17 per month when billed annually.
facts.quote: $20/month or $17/month annually

facts.fact: Replit's Pro plan costs $100 per month, or $95 per month when billed annually.
facts.quote: $100/month or $95/month annually

facts.fact: Replit's Core plan includes $20 of credit toward the most powerful models.
facts.quote: $20 toward the most powerful models

facts.fact: Replit's Pro plan includes $100 of credit toward the most powerful models.
facts.quote: $100 toward the most powerful models

facts.fact: Replit states that current plans support two parallel agents on Core and ten on Pro.
facts.quote: Current plans support two parallel agents on Core and ten on Pro

facts.fact: Replit's Core plan allows up to 5 collaborators.
facts.quote: Up to 5 collaborators

facts.fact: Replit's Pro plan allows up to 15 collaborators and 50 viewers.
facts.quote: Up to 15 collaborators and 50 viewers

facts.fact: Replit's Starter plan allows one live project that expires after 30 days.
facts.quote: One live project that expires after 30 days

facts.fact: Replit's Pro plan includes database rollback of up to 28 days.
facts.quote: Database rollback up to 28 days

facts.fact: Replit states that Core and Pro support unlimited published projects, with infrastructure usage billed through credits, while Starter includes one published project for 30 days.
facts.quote: Starter includes one published project for 30 days, while Core and Pro support unlimited published projects with infrastructure usage billed through credits.

facts.fact: Replit states that usage beyond the Core plan's included credits can be billed separately.
facts.quote: Usage beyond included credits can be billed separately

facts.fact: Replit's pricing information was checked on August 29, 2026.
facts.quote: Pricing checked August 29, 2026.

facts.fact: Replit's Starter plan is free and includes daily Agent credits, limited Agent intelligence, Design Canvas, the Visual Editor, and one 30-day published project.
facts.quote: Replit’s Starter plan is free and includes daily Agent credits, limited Agent intelligence, Design Canvas, the Visual Editor, and one 30-day published project.

facts.fact: Full builds and Plan Mode require a paid Replit plan, according to the page.
facts.quote: Full builds and Plan Mode require a paid plan.

facts.fact: Replit's Core plan costs $20 per month when billed monthly.
facts.quote: Core is $20 monthly or $17 per month billed annually

facts.fact: Replit's Pro plan costs $100 per month when billed monthly.
facts.quote: Pro is $100 monthly or $95 per month billed annually.

facts.fact: Agent and cloud usage can create additional charges after included credits are consumed.
facts.quote: Agent and cloud usage can create additional charges after included credits are consumed.

facts.fact: Paid Replit Agent work is priced by complexity and work performed rather than a flat per-message fee, and Replit shows task costs and asks for confirmation before a paid action begins.
facts.quote: Paid Agent work is priced according to the complexity and work performed rather than a flat per-message fee.

facts.fact: Replit credits can apply to Agent work and to cloud services including published apps, storage, databases, and certain third-party AI integrations.
facts.quote: Credits can apply to Agent work and cloud services including published apps, storage, databases, and certain third-party AI integrations.

facts.fact: Replit Agent checkpoints can restore files, Agent context, tasks, and optionally database state.
facts.quote: Checkpoints record completed work and can restore files, Agent context, tasks, and optionally database state.

facts.fact: Plan Mode can perform billable reasoning on the paid path even when it does not change files.
facts.quote: Plan Mode can perform billable reasoning in the paid path even when it does not change files
